stage.scope: finite-map side-view dig/place sandbox with chunked terrain persistence
notInScope: liquids, lighting propagation, multiplayer, physics materials
reusing the side-view ability-gate acceptance matrix as sandbox evidence

reused: movement model (gravity, run/air acceleration, coyote time, jump buffer, variable jump height)
character body conventions (origin at the feet, up_direction = up, MOTION_MODE_GROUNDED)
input source abstraction (human and scripted input share one path)
notReused: room_manager one-room-at-a-time lifecycle (the sandbox streams finite chunks instead)
ability gates and the side-view acceptance matrix

blank.description: Finite 48x24 authored-generator map, dig/place/inventory/save only, no recipes and no rewards.

mine-camp.description: Finite 96x48 mining camp: dig soil, stone, coal and iron, craft a stone pickaxe, then an iron ingot and an iron pickaxe at the camp station, and build with stone bricks.

capabilities: stable chunk identity with boundary chunks
reach-, target-, occupancy- and adjacency-validated dig and place
drops into inventory with request idempotency
no burying the player in solid tiles
per-chunk atomic persistence with index hashes
strict whole-file rejection of corrupt, missing or version-mismatched progress
atomic save with backup recovery and honest write-failure reporting
read-only snapshot and headless probe over the real gameplay code path
entityIdScheme: stable string id declared in world data, never a node path
chunkScheme: chunk id is "<cx>_<cy>" with cx = floor(tileX / chunkTiles[0]); the last chunk of each axis is partial when mapSize is not a multiple of chunkTiles

hostBoundary.testInterface: probe is dormant unless --probe and both --probe-request/--probe-response are passed; it drives the same methods the game uses and cannot write expected results
